correctness.rationale: For a Haar-uniform plane normal u, failure of projected antipodal vertex pair i is exactly |u_i|/a_i >= sum of the other two scaled absolute coordinates; the six-vertex event is a strict triangle-inequality cone in each octant. The standard trihedral solid-angle formula gives p=(4/pi)atan(2abc/D). AM--GM gives L_ab L_ac L_bc/(abc)>=2sqrt(2) and (a^2 L_bc+...)/(abc)>=3sqrt(2), with simultaneous equality iff a=b=c. Thus sharp global bound and strict equality follow. On centered log-axis line (t,-t,0), independently differentiated exact radicals give D/(abc)=5sqrt(2)+(27sqrt(2)/4)t^2+O(t^4) and p difference sqrt(2)t^2/pi; permutation symmetry makes Hessian isotropic, giving coefficient 1/(sqrt(2)pi). Scale and strict positivity hypotheses handled; no nonorthogonal claim.
